name: academic-research
description: A social science research partner: learns your research preferences, hunts literature against them, teaches and drafts literature reviews, selects and justifies methods, runs the analysis in Stata or R with an operations manual and runnable templates, draws theory and causal diagrams, enforces APA/ASA/Chicago/GB-T 7714 formatting, and turns results into a defensible contribution. Fully bilingual: 中文提问, 中文回答. 社会科学研究助手, 支持文献检索, 文献综述, 研究方法, Stata 与 R 操作, 理论模型图, 参考文献格式与结论撰写.
